verdict.rationale: Rippling's benefits docs describe offering integrated health/HSA/FSA benefits with deductions that 'always sync with payroll,' automated enrollment reopening, EOI processing that updates coverage and adjusts payroll deductions in bulk, and AI-assisted plan comparison/enrollment for employees—directly matching the ops story of administering health insurance with payroll-synced deductions. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration specific to benefits enrollment-to-payroll sync (community evidence only covers payroll timing incidents and general praise, not benefits admin specifically).
